title: astracantha crassinervia
intro: Astracantha crassinervia, commonly known as the Spiny Acacia, is a perennial shrub in the pea family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and digestive problems, due to its reported health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Astracantha crassinervia include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate pain, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Bioactive constituents of Astracantha crassinervia, such as quercetin, kaempferol, and isorhapontigenin, have been identified to contribute to its medicinal properties.
